name: RATAN-600
description: A ring of 895 rectangular radio reflectors, each 2 m x 7.4 m, in a 576 m diameter circle at 970 m altitude, run by the Special Astrophysical Observatory. With its central receiver it has the resolving power of a nearly 600-metre dish.
highlights: Described as the world's largest-diameter individual radio telescope.
Used to study blazars and other radio sources.
